verdict.rationale: Netlify's deploy pipeline provides versioning via git-based deploys, review via Deploy Previews on every PR, and one-click rollback to any prior deploy, directly matching the version/review/rollback story for its core automation (site deploys); community feedback independently praises the PR preview workflow. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of rollback specifically, and evidence extending versioning/rollback to other 'automations' like serverless functions or AI agent workflows beyond the site deploy itself.
